# Pixel art: every character's close-up portrait (ready-to-paste ChatGPT prompts)

<!-- Generated by tools/pixel/portrait_prompts.py from tools/pixel/portrait_cast.json and the style block and expressions in docs/pixel-art-brief.md. Don't edit by hand: change those and run the tool. -->

A front-facing, chest-up pixel portrait for every character with a personal quest or real dialogue: the companions, the main story, the villains and bosses who speak, and the named supporting cast. They're the faces in the dialogue box and in cutscene close-ups (`docs/pixel-art-brief.md` §4). The player and {sb} aren't here: their faces are the layered kit (brief §4.6, `docs/pixel-art-batch-1.md` §2).

**How to use it.** For each character: start a **new chat**, attach the template the card names (they're in `tools/source/pixel/templates/`), and paste the first block whole. Then stay in the **same chat** and paste each expression's block, one message each, saving each picture under the name in its last line. Staying in one chat keeps the face, the pixels and the framing the same in every expression. If a picture comes back cropped, zoomed, turned or moved, use **Fix the size** at the end and do it again.

**Where the files go.** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/<id>/`, one folder per character (a variant's pictures go in its character's folder).

**What to send Claude.** A character's whole set at a time. Claude snaps each picture to a true 96 × 96 pixel grid, cleans the palette, and animates it (blinking, talking, breathing, the expression changes, brief §4.3). Paint the companions first; Brannock's set is the pilot (batch 1), so send it before the rest, in case the prompts need a change.

| Main story | King Leon, Archmage Thessaly Varn, Captain Roderic Hale, Commander Aldric Voss, Brenna of Ashfall, Sir Corwin Halbeck, Davin, Mother Superior Anselle, Sister Orla, Lady Isadora, Corra | 133 |
| Villains and bosses | Maleficio, Varkhul, the Hollow Knight, Lord Severin Morvaine, Vorlaith, the Unmade King, Lord Chancellor Vesper Crane, Vesk, Vreya, Mordain, Bosun Grell, Mother Gannet, Lord Harrow of Heronsgate | 129 |

Expressions by tier (brief §4.2): **main** all 13; **named** 8 (neutral, angry, disgust, smile, laugh, sad, shock, worried); **minor** 6 (neutral and the five: angry, disgust, smile, laugh, sad). A missing one falls back to the nearest, so a set works before it's finished.

## Companions

### Sera Vantis · `sera`
Sylvan warden of the Mirewood's western reach. Joins A1-C2 with her kestrel Burr. Romanceable. Personal quest **The Last Silverbark** (A1-C7)  
**Tier:** main (13 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/sera/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-female.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Sera Vantis: Sylvan (a long-lived fantasy people with long, pointed ears), about 140; looks late twenties. Porcelain skin; fine oval face, high cheekbones, narrow nose, composed unsmiling mouth; clear green eyes under straight, elegant honey brows. Long pointed Sylvan ears. Honey-blonde hair in one long braid brought over the left shoulder to the waist. Faint squint-lines from weather. Collar: moss-green ranger's coat with a stand collar and thin cream piping over an oatmeal shirt; short dark-moss-green wool shoulder cape, hood down, fastened with a wooden toggle; undyed-leather quiver strap across the chest; the longbow's tip rising past the right shoulder. Keep their signature colours clear: moss green, undyed leather. The feel of the face: watchful, flat, dry, quietly guarded.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

I'll save it as portrait-sera.neutral.png.
```

### Kael Duskmantle · `kael`
Emberkin thief from Tallow Lane in the Low Ring. Joins A1-C4 (the Vault). Romanceable. Personal quest **A Name on a Door** (A1-C7). Can turn and become the Protectorate's Shadow, an Act 3 boss  
**Tier:** main (13 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/kael/`.

## Main story

### King Leon · `leon`
King of Fable and Elara's father. Speaks through Acts 1-3; spoke for Brannock forty-one years ago. In furs and ill in Act 3; killed by {sb} at A3-C2-03  
**Tier:** main (13 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/leon/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-male.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. King Leon: human (Aurelian), early sixties. Fair skin; deeply lined, gentle face, drooping lids over kind grey eyes, bushy silver brows, big nose, hollowed cheeks, thin gentle mouth. Silver hair swept back to the collar and a short, neat silver beard. A small, plain gold crown, a simple band with low points and one ruby at the front. Collar: a broad ermine collar (white fur with small black tips) over a white robe-coat trimmed in sun gold, a gold sash across it; a heavy navy cloak falling behind. Keep their signature colours clear: white, sun gold. The feel of the face: tired, courteous, plain-spoken, kind.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

I'll save it as portrait-leon.neutral.png.
```

### Archmage Thessaly Varn · `thessaly`
Head of the Mages Guild at the Arcanum Spire. Briefs the Doomward mission (A1-C7-02) and guards the Deepvault. Sealed in crystal by {sb} (A3-C2-02), freed at A3-C4-03. Trainer (Guild Battlemage, later Hourwarden)  
**Tier:** main (13 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/thessaly/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-female.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Archmage Thessaly Varn: human, 60. Fair skin; lean, sharp face, deep lines round the mouth, long nose, thin lips pressed together; steady, piercing grey eyes under thin grey brows. Grey hair cropped close to the skull. A single plain steel ear stud. Collar: a short deep-cobalt mantle with a high collar over a cobalt robe, both banded with a plain repeated geometric motif in pale silver thread; a slim book on a chain at the chest. the left hand is missing its ring and little fingers, healed long ago. Keep their signature colours clear: Guild cobalt. The feel of the face: clipped, exacting, unflappable, bone-dry.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

I'll save it as portrait-thessaly.neutral.png.

### Davin · `davin`
Corwin's squire, who carries Corwin's sword. Leads SQ3-Gilded if Corwin died; trainer (Gilded Knight)  
**Tier:** named (8 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/davin/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-male.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Davin: human, about 17. Tan skin; smooth, eager young face, soft jaw not yet filled out, straight nose a little big for it, clean-shaven; wide-open brown eyes. Short, messy dark-brown hair, no helm, no plume. Collar: a mail shirt a little big for him; over it a white tabard with a large gold sun, plainly cut down from a bigger man's and re-hemmed by hand in uneven stitches; the hilt of Corwin's too-big sword at one shoulder. Keep their signature colours clear: gold-white. The feel of the face: earnest, grieving, trying to stand tall.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

I'll save it as portrait-davin.neutral.png.
```

```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. ### Varkhul, the Hollow Knight · `varkhul`
Brenna's father, Hollowed twelve years ago. Boss of Greywatch (A1-C6-01); unmasked, he dies asking to be remembered as a knight  
**Tier:** named (8 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/varkhul/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-male.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Varkhul, the Hollow Knight: human (Hollowed), about 70, build tall, wide. No face shows: a closed great helm of blackened iron, its visor cracked down the middle, one burning ember-orange eye in the crack. Massive, tall shoulders. Collar: blackened full plate, ash grey at the edges, old and fine under the corruption, with a faded engraved crest on the breastplate; cracked seams leak a dull ember-orange glow; a ragged ash-grey surcoat and a tattered, scorched ash-grey cloak hang in strips. The shard in his greatsword hilt glows violet-black if the hilt is in frame. Keep their signature colours clear: ash, ember. The feel of the face: hollow, halting, menacing, mournful.

His face is hidden by the helm: show each expression through the burning eye in the visor's crack (narrowed, flaring, dimmed), the tilt of the head and the set of the shoulders.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

### Vorlaith, the Unmade King · `vorlaith`
An ancient thing that comes through the time-tear. Speaks four times in Act 3 (A3-C5-02, A3-C5-07); Act 4's threat  
**Tier:** main (13 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/vorlaith/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-male.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Vorlaith, the Unmade King: other (a being of living glass), ancient. A head of clear, colourless glass cracked with fine branching fractures, a cold white light drifting inside it like smoke in a bottle; smooth, calm, faintly amused features; two points of white light for eyes; no hair, only a faint glassy brow ridge. A crown of broken clock-hands, old dark iron and brass of different sizes, pointing every way. Collar: the same cracked glass forming a high collar and long, still robes, the light brightest in the chest. Keep their signature colours clear: colourless glass, white light. The feel of the face: calm, ancient, faintly amused.

The face is glass: show each expression in the glass features and in the light inside, which brightens, dims or flickers with the mood.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

### Mother Gannet · `gannet`
Owns every door on Tallow Lane and is doubling the rents; changes Doomward marks for Crane's people. The antagonist of Kael's **A Name on a Door**  
**Tier:** named (8 expressions). **Folder:** `tools/source/pixel/portraits/gannet/`.
**New chat.** **Attach:** `templates/portrait-template-female.png`.
```text
STYLE. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Mother Gannet: human, about 60, build wide. Fair skin; broad face, apple cheeks, broad nose, a wide mouth that smiles without warmth; shrewd brown eyes with crinkles. Silver hair under a small white lace cap pinned on top. Wide shoulders. Collar: a heavy mustard-yellow wool shawl pinned with a large brass brooch over a brown wool dress; ringed fingers holding a pen over a ledger. Keep their signature colours clear: mustard, brown. The feel of the face: shrewd, cold, grasping, matronly.

EXPRESSION. Neutral: calm, eyes open looking straight at the viewer, brows level, mouth closed and relaxed.

Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. A pixel-art character portrait for a cosy high-fantasy role-playing game's dialogue box: a chest-up close-up with the face looking straight at the viewer, the head and shoulders square to the camera and centred. Anime-flavoured and charming: large, expressive eyes with a big coloured iris, a dark pupil and one or two bright square highlights; clear, bold eyebrows; a small, simple nose shown with a pixel or two of shadow; a small mouth whose shape changes clearly with the mood; hair in big, clean, chunky locks with a bright highlight band. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines. Chibi or super-deformed proportions; a huge head on a tiny body. A three-quarter view, a profile, a tilted head or eyes looking away, unless the expression asks for it. Sweat drops, anger marks, blush lines or tear streams drawn beside the face (the game adds those). Scenery, a frame, a border, a name plate, a speech bubble. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is the template, exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1024. Paint the character over the grey mannequin exactly where it is, facing straight out: the eyes on the dashed line across the middle of the head, either side of the dashed centre line; the chin on the dashed line just under the face; the base of the neck on the dotted line below that; the shoulders filling the bottom edge; the top of the hair (or hat, hood or helm) inside the dashed box. The dashed lines are only guides: paint over them, and make the background flat #00FF00 green everywhere else. Don't crop, zoom, re-centre or re-frame it.

CHARACTER. Tobin Ashgrove: human, mid-fifties. Fair, freckled skin; round, pleasant face, soft cheeks, short nose; kind brown eyes with laugh lines; a short copper beard; thin copper hair, bald on the crown. Collar: an apple-green work shirt with rolled sleeves under the bib of a heavy, stained brown leather presser's apron. If his left hand shows: a wide old burn scar across its back. Real low-resolution pixel art: the whole picture is a grid of about 96 by 96 big square pixels, each about 10 to 11 image pixels wide, every one a single flat colour, with no anti-aliasing, blur, gradient or texture inside it. A small palette of about 24 to 32 colours in ramps of three or four tones per material: shadows cooler and more violet, highlights warmer and more golden. A one-pixel outline in dark brown-violet, never pure black, around the hair, face and shoulders, with lighter coloured lines inside. Soft, colourful cel shading, lit from above and slightly in front. Normal proportions for a bust (not chibi): the age, people and personality of the character obvious at a glance, and the high-fantasy costume shown at the collar and shoulders as bold, simple shapes (trims, clasps, gems, armour edges, fur). Plain, flat background in exactly #00FF00 green, right up to the edges.

AVOID. Smooth, painterly, vector or high-resolution rendering; small or uneven pixels; gradients; photographic texture or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines.
